feeds.title: Her Campus
feeds.description: Her Campus is the top global community for college women, covering style, beauty, health, love, life, career, & more. Her Campus Media founders Stephanie Kaplan Lewis, Annie Wang, and Windsor Hanger Western met as Harvard undergrads while running a student publication for women on campus. The publication soared in popularity with college women across the country, who began asking for advice on starting something like it at their own schools.

feeds.title: College Fashion
feeds.description: College Fashion is the original and #1 fashion and beauty blog written by college students, for college students. Featuring fashion tips for students, the latest fashion trends, beauty tips, decor ideas, college lifestyle tips, and style advice for 20-somethings, CF is a college woman's daily source for all things fabulous.

feeds.title: HBCU Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: We're committed to keeping you connected to the black college living experience, bringing you the latest on everything, from scholarships and dorm living to Greek life and alumni giving. HBCU Lifestyle is led by Richard and Garrick Gibson, a father and son team with a passion for Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU).

feeds.title: College Info Geek
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Thomas Frank. My team and I built College Info Geek from the ground up to help you learn effectively, spend less time studying, and become more productive (even if you're not in college).

feeds.title: College Magazine
feeds.description: The ultimate college guide was written by students at your campus. From university rankings to career advice & academic tips to student health. We share advice on the college experience and want to bring you designs that reflect campus culture. Our articles for college students feature university rankings of U.S. colleges, college guides, academic advice, college prep, career advice, student health, and collegiate dating tips.

feeds.title: The Olden Chapters
feeds.description: College and Millennial Lifestyle Blog sharing secrets on student life, productivity, goal setting, career development, budgeting and more. Sarah is a student herself have completed three undergraduate degrees in geology, environmental science,civil engineering and knows the struggles in and out so she helps others on how to enjoy life as a college student.

feeds.title: Gabby In The City
feeds.description: Key topics covered are college lifestyle, New York living, financial management. Gabby In The City is a college life + style blog from two college girls.

feeds.title: Every College Girl » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Find some helpful articles for college life. Our mission is simple: Empower college girls everywhere by sharing the knowledge and experiences every college girl should know. We are an enthusiastic team of college girls from across North America, coming together to create a vibrant and engaging online space.

feeds.title: Sincerely Meghan Ann » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Sincerely Meghan Ann is Meghan's creative outlet. She shares her experiences of life. She also writes for college students, her travels, college life and more.

feeds.title: The College Gems
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jordan! You can think of me as your college big sis, giving you all the inside information so you can experience all that college has to offer. The College Gems is a college lifestyle blog dedicated to helping you navigate college life by spilling all the GEMS you need to live the best years of your life.

feeds.title: Uniquely Mickie Blog
feeds.description: Uniquely Mickie is a collge lifestyle blog focused on helping pharmacy students and pharmacists who struggle with work-life balance. Makaela is a style blogger and pharmacist who shares pharmacy advice, travel tips, and plenty of my lifestyle favorites.

feeds.title: College Blender
feeds.description: Covers eduactional tips, travel, wellness, fashion, tech, career and more. College Blender.com is a complete college lifestyle resource from tips on choosing a study abroad program.

feeds.title: CollegeCandy
feeds.description: College Candy is the leading lifestyle site for college-aged women. We cover everything from pop culture news to what's happening on college campuses nationwide, whether it means the latest fashion and beauty trends or dating and relationship advice.

feeds.title: College Cures
feeds.description: College Cures is your guide to life in college and beyond. A resource for advice, tips and solutions to everything you'll encounter when going to college. From parties and hangovers to midterms and studying, we've got you covered. We're your college life advisors.

feeds.title: Ryality » Lifestyle
feeds.description: College lifestyle blog aiming to help young women be successful in school and life. Ryan Predieri herself is a college student and shares advices on how to manage both school and life.

feeds.title: Simplifying College
feeds.description: Simplifying College is a university & college life blog and resource for all things college and dorm related, as told by a recent college grad. Tons of college gift guides, college tips, and solutions for students, recent graduates, and young professionals. We're a college guidebook for college life, college gifts, and everything in between to help you succeed in your young life.

feeds.title: College Life Made Easy
feeds.description: I'm Charlie and I'm one of the co-founders of College Life Made Easy! At College Life Made Easy, my number one goal is to help busy & broke students THRIVE during their college experience.This is a community for college students. Find real-life advice on topics like finance, dorm living, organization, scholarships, and more.

feeds.title: College Fashionista » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Discover some hacks, tips, and more for college fashion. College Fashionista writes about fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and careers. One can also find advice that will help yu not only in college but life.
